A WORD TO TAKE WITH YOU

분식 bunsik

Think gimbap, tteokbokki and quick bowls of noodles. A bunsik shop is a good place to start reading a Korean menu: familiar ingredients, short dish names, plenty to choose from.

Here, 김밥 means gimbap, 떡볶이 means tteokbokki, and 라면 means ramyeon. Tap a dish to see its options before adding it. Prices and choices in this practice shop are fictional.
